system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, this is Isabella Johansson. I just got my recent order, and I need some help with a couple of things. I want to return the hose and the backpack, and also exchange the hiking boots I got for the exact same ones, but in the waterproof version. Can you help me with both of these at the same time? I’d really like to get this sorted quickly, please.

Thanks, Isabella — I can help with that. First I need to verify your account before I look up your orders. Please either:

- Give the email address on your account, or  
- Confirm your full name (you already gave Isabella Johansson) and your ZIP code.

If you have the order ID handy, please include that as well (it speeds things up). Also confirm:
- The package you received is marked “delivered,” and  
- You’re returning the hose and the backpack, and exchanging the hiking boots for the same boots in the waterproof version.

Finally, let me know how you’d like the refund for the returned items: refund to the original payment method or to an existing gift card on file? (For exchanges, any price difference will need a payment method — gift card or original card — and a gift card must have enough balance.)

Once you provide your email or name+ZIP (and order ID if you have it), I’ll look up your order and list the specific items and next steps for your confirmation.

I actually don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Isabella Johansson and my ZIP code is 32286. I don’t have the order ID handy right now, sorry.

Yes, the package was marked “delivered” and I have everything here. I want to return the hose and the backpack, and exchange the hiking boots for the waterproof version of the same boots.

For the refund, I’d prefer it go back to my original payment method.

Is there anything else you need from me? I’m hoping we can move this along quickly—thanks!

Thanks — and sorry, I ran into a system error trying to look up your account by name and ZIP. I can still help, but I need one of these to authenticate and pull up your order so I can start the return/exchange:

- the email on the account, or  
- the order ID (if you can find it).

A few quick confirmations so I have everything ready once I can access your order:
- You want to return: the hose and the backpack (yes/no?).  
- You want to exchange: the hiking boots for the exact same boots in the waterproof version (yes/no?). Please confirm you have the boots ready to send back as part of the exchange.  
- Refund for the returns should go to your original payment method (you already said yes — confirm).  
- For the exchange price difference (if the waterproof version costs more or less), do you want that charged/refunded to the original payment method as well? (If you prefer a gift card, let me know and confirm it has sufficient balance.)

If you’d rather not provide email/order ID here, I can transfer you to a human agent — would you like me to do that? If yes, I’ll transfer and you’ll see a message telling you you’re being transferred.

Once you provide either the email or order ID (and confirm the four bullets above), I’ll look up your order and list the exact items and the next steps for your explicit confirmation before making any changes.

I’m sorry, I really don’t remember the email or have the order ID with me right now. Is there any other way to look up my order? I just want to get this done as quickly as possible.

To confirm:
- Yes, I want to return the hose and the backpack.
- Yes, I want to exchange the hiking boots for the exact same boots in the waterproof version, and I have the boots here, ready to send back.
- Yes, please refund the returns to my original payment method.
- For any price difference on the boots, please use the original payment method as well.

If you really can’t help without the email or order ID, then please transfer me to a human agent—I just want to get this sorted out. Thank you.
